turns.assessment: The decisive evidence is the EQPT_PORT_FAIL alarm on svc200's S22 client port at the same onset as the service failure. The remote CLIENT_SF at S23 is consistent with propagation of the interrupted client signal. All monitored line interfaces, optical spans, amplifiers, and channel monitors remained stable, while many other services sharing those resources stayed up, strongly excluding an optical-path or shared transport failure.

proposals.rationale: O3 directly identifies an equipment-port failure at this client port at t=602.5. It explains the simultaneous local and remote client signal-fail alarms without any optical telemetry change or impact to neighboring services.
A failure at the opposite client endpoint could interrupt this service alone, but S23 raised only CLIENT_SF while the explicit EQPT_PORT_FAIL was at S22.
